Method of Attack: Phishing kit used to collect credentials after victims input them on phishing landing pages
Use of compromised SharePoint sites and malicious OneNote documents to redirect victims
Delivery of phishing emails from compromised accounts with URLs linking to attacker-controlled SharePoint sites
Phishing landing pages impersonating OneDrive for Business login pages to harvest credentials
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with embedded URLs to compromised SharePoint sites
Malicious OneNote documents with embedded links to phishing landing pages
Phishing landing pages mimicking legitimate Microsoft login portals
Indicators of Compromise: IP addresses, URLs, and email accounts used by attackers as listed in Cofense report
